key.description: One policy leaf: retention.<kind>, sensitivity.<kind>, thresholds.<name>, packs or open_weights_endpoint. Secrets and whole mappings are refused.

value.description: Typed JSON value, validated for the selected key. Retention is 1–36500 days or null; sensitivity is normal/private; packs is a distinct list of meetings/receipts; thresholds are bounded positive integers; endpoint is Baseten HTTPS or loopback HTTP(S), or null.
